notablePrerequisites:
Raptor Hatchling has toughness 2 or greater.
You have a way to cause a Dinosaur to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Cause a Dinosaur to enter the battlefield under your control.
Forerunner of the Empire's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each creature.
Raptor Hatchling triggers, and Rite of Passage triggers for each of your creatures dealt damage this way.
Resolve all Rite of Passage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Raptor Hatchling trigger, creating a 3/3 Dinosaur creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
